transcript:
Interviewer: This intake belongs only to the Republic of Alderhaven, a fictional demonstration jurisdiction.
Caller: End our marriage. That is my main request.
Caller: I am Mael Pond and my spouse is Zia Pond.
Caller: My present home is 58 Demonstration Square Sampletown.
Caller: We married on 2008-04-18 and separated on 2025-02-28.
Caller: We have one child, Enna Pond born 2011-08-17.
Interviewer: What arrangement do you want the draft to describe?
Caller: Alternate full weeks with handover every Friday at 18:00.
Caller: That is my proposed arrangement, not something Zia has agreed to.
